x: 880 yards (Junior): 1 Parlett (D.); 2 Brown (B.); 3 Fenner (W.); 4 Bates (B.); 5 Pymm (W.); 6 Stirling (B.).

Bates, our runner in the "Half," showed up very well in his heat to gain second place and reach the final. He was unplaced in this but might possibly have done better if he had gone away with the field at the start instead of making a last quarter effort, which did not avail him much.
